decisions.reason: Identifies the profile and bundle workspace-files inserts, locates the failure at EntryGroup.update during include application, and rejects silent merging.
Clearly distinguishes config override, genuinely new insert, and duplicate bundle-provided insert, and classifies the maintainer action using both excerpts.
Prescribes deleting only the redundant profile workspace-files insert while preserving bundle and other profile entries, with override as the config path.
Explains the crash happens before plugin execution, cannot be fixed in plugin code, and separates the earlier read failure for later verification.
Recommends grepping the installed bundle patch before inserting and proposes an actionable duplicate diagnostic naming both origins and deletion remedy.
